body: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
plain_description: **Serve large language and multimodal models for your business applications.** Use SGLang for high performance inference, agentic workloads, and large scale serving. It also includes tools for generating images, video, audio, and actions.
technical_description: SGLang is an open-source inference framework for large language, vision-language, and diffusion models, optimized for agentic workloads, large-scale serving, and reinforcement learning rollouts. Its built-in SGLang Diffusion engine supports image, video, audio, and action generation. The README describes Docker and Python installation, broad GPU, TPU, NPU, CPU, and Apple Silicon support, and deployment integrations.
title: SGLang
